comments.comment: Indonesian here!  To be honest I don't really know about Philippines until I saw this video. There are so many things in common between Indonesia and Philippines. Basically, Indonesia and Philippines are like the forgotten cousins.  We, Indonesian (especially the Sundanese, Javanese, and some other tribes), also do this kind of thing 13:47 to our elders and parents. I personally always do that to my parents and grandparents everytime I go out (to school, college, or playing with my friends). It shows the sign of respect to the elders. Here, in West Java, we called it "Salim".  When I was child, the elders or my parents always said :  "Udah salim belom?" ("Have you "salim" yet?") "Jangan lupa salim dulu ya" ("Don't forget to do the "salim", okay?") "Ehh ayo sini salim dulu" ("Hey, come here and do the "salim" (to us)") Etc.  And the traditional dishes, man I can say that the South East Asian Countries absolutely love coconut, pandan, and rice. Because the traditional dishes look kinda same but I with different recipe and name (this is my opinion though).  Well, it's fun to know about other culture especieally from South East Asian countries.  Greetings from Indonesia 🇲🇨
